purpose: Compile two-sweep finite P1 candidate. Reuse native FA backward transpose layouts, FP32 atomic accumulation pattern and unmodified convert_dQ. Keep actual model/default FA and finite centered coefficient unchanged; summation order explicitly changes. No model or GPU execution in build.

local_review_if_compiled.scope: Old captured real NI0 layer35, not a new benchmark. Six operator calls,1warm+2alternating measured.
local_review_if_compiled.dq_gate: Finite DQ must have relativeL2 error<=0.001 and max_abs_error<=0.01*old_RMS. This is an engineering screen, not a bound on attribution/sign/quality. Retain all per-output errors and sign flips; do not relax gate after results.
local_review_if_compiled.performance: All preparation, FP32 accumulation workspace and native conversion included. No automatic full sweep.
